### Input Modifiers

```yaml
# Reusable input modifiers for the shooter genre. Referenced by name in Input Mappings.
# StickDeadzone and MouseSensitivity are player-configurable; the others are tuning knobs
# owned by the designer. All modifiers sit in the per-binding modifier pipeline and run
# in the order they are listed on each binding.

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: StickDeadzone
Type: DeadZone
Params:
  DeadZoneShape: Radial
  InnerThreshold: 0.15
  OuterThreshold: 0.95
UserConfigurable: true
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Stick Dead Zone
  Description: Radial dead zone for analog sticks - ignores drift below 15% and saturates above 95%

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: MouseSensitivity
Type: Sensitivity
Params:
  Multiplier: 1.0
  MultiplierX: 1.0
  MultiplierY: 1.0
UserConfigurable: true
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Mouse Sensitivity
  Description: Per-axis mouse sensitivity multiplier exposed in the player settings screen

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: TriggerThreshold
Type: TriggerThreshold
Params:
  PressThreshold: 0.5
UserConfigurable: false
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Trigger Threshold
  Description: Analog trigger press threshold - values below 0.5 are treated as released

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: AimAssistCurve
Type: ResponseCurve
Params:
  CurveType: Exponential
  Exponent: 2.5
UserConfigurable: false
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Aim Assist Curve
  Description: Exponential response curve for gamepad aiming - slower near center, faster at extremes

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: RadialScaling
Type: RadialScaling
Params:
  MaxRadius: 1.0
UserConfigurable: false
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Radial Scaling
  Description: Normalizes stick input to a maximum radius of 1.0 for consistent diagonal movement
```

### Tag Registry

```yaml
# Shooter genre tag taxonomy. ADDITIVE: introduces genre-specific tags only.
# It does not redefine the core lifecycle tags (State.Alive / State.Combat / State.Dead) -
# those are referenced by the pack's entities, not declared here.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_tag.json
Tags:
  # --- Weapon-handling states (granted by Effects; tag ownership follows responsibility) ---
  - Tag: State.Aiming
    Description: Aiming down sights; granted by GE_ADS, removed when the aim input is released
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: State.Reloading
    Description: A reload is in progress; granted by GE_Reloading, blocks firing and aiming
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: State.Sprinting
    Description: Tactical sprint state (owned by the movement system); documented for a sprint extension
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Weapon classification & loadout (granted by equip / attachment Effects) ---
  - Tag: Weapon.Equipped
    Description: A weapon is equipped and ready; gate for the fire/reload/aim abilities
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Weapon.Type.Rifle
    Description: Automatic rifle
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Weapon.Type.Pistol
    Description: Sidearm
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Weapon.Type.Shotgun
    Description: Close-range spread weapon
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Weapon.Type.Sniper
    Description: Long-range precision rifle
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Weapon.FireMode.Auto
    Description: Fully automatic fire while the trigger is held
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Weapon.FireMode.SemiAuto
    Description: One shot per trigger pull
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Weapon.FireMode.Burst
    Description: A fixed burst of rounds per trigger pull
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Weapon.Attachment.Barrel
    Description: A muzzle/barrel attachment is fitted; granted by GE_AttachmentBarrel
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Ability classification ---
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Fire
    Description: Primary fire ability
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Reload
    Description: Reload ability
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Aim
    Description: Aim-down-sights ability
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Movement
    Description: Locomotion ability (sprint, slide, vault)
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Damage types ---
  - Tag: DamageType.Ballistic
    Description: Kinetic projectile / hitscan damage
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: DamageType.Explosive
    Description: Area damage from grenades and rockets
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Hitzones (drive the headshot damage multiplier) ---
  - Tag: Hitzone.Head
    Description: Hit landed on the head; the hit-resolution calc applies HeadshotMultiplier
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Hitzone.Body
    Description: Hit landed on the torso; baseline damage
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Hitzone.Limb
    Description: Hit landed on a limb; typically reduced damage
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Teams & immunity ---
  - Tag: Team.Friendly
    Description: Same team as the source; used to skip friendly fire
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Team.Hostile
    Description: Opposing team; a valid damage target
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Immunity.Ballistic
    Description: Ignores incoming ballistic damage (e.g. spawn protection); honored by the hit-resolution calc
    AllowMultiple: false
```

## Genre Pack: sports

### Ability Pass

```yaml
# Pass: distribute the ball to a team-mate under the reticle. Costs a little stamina (GE_PassCost:
# Stamina -2) and goes on a short cooldown (GE_PassCooldown) so passing is not free-spammed. The pass
# itself selects a friendly receiver (WaitTargetData) - PassAccuracy (momentum-boosted in the Momentum
# channel) governs how cleanly it arrives. GE_PassCost and GE_PassCooldown are trivial (a flat
# resource cost and a cooldown tag) and are referenced by name rather than shipped as files, the same
# convention the racing and shooter packs use for their cost/cooldown effects.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_ability.json
Name: GA_Pass
Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Pass
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
Cost: GE_PassCost
Cooldown: GE_PassCooldown
Tasks:
  - Type: WaitTargetData
    Params:
      TargetingMethod: ReceiverSelect
      RequiredTags:
        - Team.Friendly
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Pass
  Description: Play the ball to a team-mate; accuracy scales with PassAccuracy
  Icon: ui/icons/pass.png
```

### Ability Shoot

```yaml
# Shoot: attempt on goal. Costs stamina (GE_ShootCost: Stamina -8 - a hard effort) and goes on a
# cooldown (GE_ShootCooldown) covering the shot animation/recovery. It traces toward goal
# (WaitTargetData), then applies GE_ShotAttempt to the goal target, which runs ExecCalc_ShotResolution
# to couple ShotPower / ShotAccuracy / Stamina / defender pressure into EffectiveShotPower and a goal
# outcome. GE_ShootCost and GE_ShootCooldown are trivial and referenced by name, like the racing/shooter
# cost/cooldown effects. A tired athlete shoots with reduced ShotAccuracy (the GE_Fatigue coupling),
# so stamina management feeds directly into finishing.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_ability.json
Name: GA_Shoot
Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Shoot
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
Cost: GE_ShootCost
Cooldown: GE_ShootCooldown
Tasks:
  - Type: WaitTargetData
    Params:
      TargetingMethod: GoalTrace
      MaxRange: 35.0
  - Type: ApplyEffectToTarget
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_ShotAttempt
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Shoot
  Description: Strike the ball at goal; outcome resolved by ExecCalc_ShotResolution from power, accuracy, stamina, and pressure
  Icon: ui/icons/shoot.png
```

### Ability Sprint

```yaml
# Sprint: hold to run flat-out, draining stamina. Applies the periodic GE_SprintDrain (which grants
# Athlete.State.Sprinting and burns Stamina every tick) and ends when the input is released - the same
# hold-then-WaitInputRelease shape as the platformer jump and the racing drift. Blocked while Fatigued,
# so once the engine's low-stamina threshold has applied GE_Fatigue the athlete cannot keep sprinting.

Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Sprint
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  ActivationBlockedTags:
    - Athlete.State.Fatigued
Tasks:
  - Type: ApplyEffectToOwner
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_SprintDrain
  - Type: WaitInputRelease
    Params:
      InputID: Sprint
  - Type: RemoveEffectFromOwner
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_SprintDrain
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Sprint
  Description: Hold to sprint at full speed, draining stamina; cannot sprint while fatigued
  Icon: ui/icons/sprint.png
```

### Attribute Set

```yaml
# Athlete performance attribute set: physical stats, on-ball skill ratings, the stamina
# resource that drives the fatigue coupling, and the team momentum meter.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/attribute_set.json
```

### Effect Fatigue

```yaml
# Fatigue coupling: the SIGNATURE mechanic of this pack and the showcase for the AttributeBased
# magnitude type (spec section 9.4.2). Instead of a static penalty, each modifier's magnitude is
# DERIVED from the live Stamina attribute, so performance scales smoothly as the athlete tires -
# no calculation code, just data.
#
# AttributeBased magnitude formula (spec section 9.4.2):
#   m = (BackingAttribute + PreMultiplyAdditive) * Coefficient + PostMultiplyAdditive
# With BackingAttribute = Stamina, PreMultiplyAdditive = -100 (so the term is Stamina - MaxStamina):
#   Speed        : m = (Stamina - 100) * 0.005   -> 0 at Stamina 100, -0.30 at Stamina 40
#   ShotAccuracy : m = (Stamina - 100) * 0.004   -> 0 at Stamina 100, -0.24 at Stamina 40
# Each modifier is a Multiply in the Fatigue channel, so the pipeline factor is (1 + m):
#   at full Stamina the factor is 1.0 (no penalty); as Stamina drops the factor shrinks.
#   e.g. Speed base 100 at Stamina 40 -> 100 * (1 - 0.30) = 70.0  (see gameplay_controller.yaml)
#
# Infinite + engine-driven: the engine applies this effect once Stamina crosses the low fatigue
# threshold and removes it once Stamina recovers above it (an attribute comparison can't be an
# activation tag, so the threshold check is engine logic - the same pattern the shooter pack uses
# for "reload only when not full"). While applied, because the magnitude reads Stamina on each
# evaluation, the penalty deepens as the athlete tires further. It also grants Athlete.State.Fatigued,
# the tag that gates GA_Sprint / GA_SkillMove.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_Fatigue
DurationPolicy: Infinite
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: Speed
    Operation: Multiply
    Magnitude:
      Type: AttributeBased
      BackingAttribute: Stamina
      Source: Target
      Coefficient: 0.005
      PreMultiplyAdditive: -100.0
    Channel: Fatigue
  - Attribute: ShotAccuracy
    Operation: Multiply
    Magnitude:
      Type: AttributeBased
      BackingAttribute: Stamina
      Source: Target
      Coefficient: 0.004
      PreMultiplyAdditive: -100.0
    Channel: Fatigue
GrantedTags:
  - Athlete.State.Fatigued
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Athlete.Fatigued
```

### Effect Injury

```yaml
# Injury (knock): a timed debuff applied when an athlete takes a heavy challenge.
# HasDuration so it wears off over the match; flat penalties to the physical stats and a lower
# MaxStamina ceiling (so the athlete also tires faster while carrying the knock). Grants
# Athlete.State.Injured for cues, substitution AI, and broadcast overlays.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_Injury
DurationPolicy: HasDuration
Duration:
  Type: ScalableFloat
  Value: 30.0
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: Speed
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -15.0
  - Attribute: Acceleration
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -20.0
  - Attribute: MaxStamina
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -20.0
GrantedTags:
  - Athlete.State.Injured
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Athlete.Injury
```

### Effect Momentum Boost

```yaml
# Momentum boost: the team-momentum half of the signature mechanic. When the Momentum meter peaks,
# the team spends it into this buff. It puts a Multiply of +0.20 on the offensive skill stats in a
# dedicated Momentum channel - a DIFFERENT channel from GE_Fatigue's Fatigue channel, so the two
# compose multiplicatively per the core pipeline (spec section 5.3): a stat can be momentum-boosted
# and fatigue-coupled at once without either cancelling the other.
#   ShotPower    : base 80 x Momentum(1 + 0.20) = 96.0
#   PassAccuracy : base 70 x Momentum(1 + 0.20) = 84.0  (see gameplay_controller.yaml)
# HasDuration so the surge self-expires; grants Team.State.HighMomentum for cues and AI.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_MomentumBoost
DurationPolicy: HasDuration
Duration:
  Type: ScalableFloat
  Value: 15.0
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: ShotPower
    Operation: Multiply
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: 0.20
    Channel: Momentum
  - Attribute: PassAccuracy
    Operation: Multiply
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: 0.20
    Channel: Momentum
GrantedTags:
  - Team.State.HighMomentum
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Team.MomentumSurge
```

### Effect Shot Attempt

```yaml
# Shot resolution, applied instantly by GA_Shoot. A shot outcome is not a single subtraction: it
# couples the shooter's (already fatigue-coupled) ShotPower and ShotAccuracy with the live Stamina
# reserve and the defender pressure on the shooter, then resolves whether the ball beats the keeper.
# That multi-attribute, source-vs-target logic can't be a static modifier, so it delegates to a custom
# Execution (ExecCalc_ShotResolution, spec section 9.5). The calc writes EffectiveShotPower and
# GoalProbability (both Meta) for telemetry/UI and applies the goal outcome. This is the sports
# analogue of the shooter pack's ExecCalc_HitResolution - the seam where a genre's signature math
# plugs into UGAS.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_ShotAttempt
DurationPolicy: Instant
Executions:
  - CalculatorClass: ExecCalc_ShotResolution
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Ball.Shot
```

### Effect Sprint Drain

```yaml
# Sprint drain: while GA_Sprint is held, periodically burn stamina.
# HasDuration + Period demonstrates timed, repeating execution (refreshed each tick the input holds).
# Grants Athlete.State.Sprinting for cues and animation; the steady -Stamina/tick is what eventually
# trips the engine's low-stamina threshold and brings GE_Fatigue (and the Fatigued tag) into play.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_SprintDrain
DurationPolicy: HasDuration
Duration:
  Type: ScalableFloat
  Value: 5.0
Period:
  Period: 0.5
  ExecuteOnApplication: true
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: Stamina
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -4.0
GrantedTags:
  - Athlete.State.Sprinting
```

### Effect Stamina Recover

```yaml
# Stamina recovery: the steady regeneration that opposes sprint/action drain.
# Infinite + Period, applied for the whole match; it tops Stamina back up between bursts of effort.
# Blocked while sprinting (ApplicationRequiredTags can't express "not sprinting", so the engine
# pauses/removes this while Athlete.State.Sprinting is present, mirroring the brief's "+Stamina while
# not sprinting"). The +Stamina is clamped at MaxStamina by the attribute's Clamping.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_StaminaRecover
DurationPolicy: Infinite
Period:
  Period: 1.0
  ExecuteOnApplication: false
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: Stamina
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: 3.0
```

### Gameplay Controller

```yaml
# Worked example: a striker deep into the match - stamina down to 40/100 with GE_Fatigue applied,
# and the team riding a GE_MomentumBoost surge. It showcases BOTH halves of the signature mechanic at
# once: the stamina->performance coupling pulling physical/skill stats DOWN, and the team-momentum
# channel pushing offensive stats UP. The Fatigue and Momentum channels are distinct, so a stat
# touched by both would multiply them; here each affected stat sits in exactly one channel, keeping
# the arithmetic easy to verify.
#
# CurrentValue columns are the result of the two active effects below, at Stamina = 40:
#   Speed:        base 100 x Fatigue(1 + (40-100)*0.005 = 0.70)            = 70.0
#   ShotAccuracy: base  75 x Fatigue(1 + (40-100)*0.004 = 0.76)            = 57.0
#   ShotPower:    base  80 x Momentum(1 + 0.20 = 1.20)                     = 96.0
#   PassAccuracy: base  70 x Momentum(1 + 0.20 = 1.20)                     = 84.0
# Acceleration, Strength, Tackling, and Composure carry no active modifier, so Current == Base.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_controller.json
OwnerActor:
  ActorID: Athlete_Striker_09
  ActorType: PlayerCharacter
AttributeSets:
  - Name: AthletePerformanceSet
    Attributes:
      - Name: MaxStamina
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: Stamina
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 40.0
      - Name: Speed
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 70.0
      - Name: Acceleration
        BaseValue: 80.0
        CurrentValue: 80.0
      - Name: Strength
        BaseValue: 70.0
        CurrentValue: 70.0
      - Name: PassAccuracy
        BaseValue: 70.0
        CurrentValue: 84.0
      - Name: ShotPower
        BaseValue: 80.0
        CurrentValue: 96.0
      - Name: ShotAccuracy
        BaseValue: 75.0
        CurrentValue: 57.0
      - Name: Tackling
        BaseValue: 65.0
        CurrentValue: 65.0
      - Name: Composure
        BaseValue: 70.0
        CurrentValue: 70.0
      - Name: MaxMomentum
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: Momentum
        BaseValue: 0.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: EffectiveShotPower
        BaseValue: 0.0
        CurrentValue: 0.0
      - Name: GoalProbability
        BaseValue: 0.0
        CurrentValue: 0.0
GrantedAbilities:
  - AbilityClass: GA_Sprint
    Level: 1
    InputID: Sprint
  - AbilityClass: GA_Pass
    Level: 1
    InputID: Pass
  - AbilityClass: GA_Shoot
    Level: 1
    InputID: Shoot
  - AbilityClass: GA_Tackle
    Level: 1
    InputID: Tackle
  - AbilityClass: GA_SkillMove
    Level: 1
    InputID: SkillMove
ActiveEffects:
  - Handle: eff-fatigue
    EffectClass: GE_Fatigue
    Duration: -1
  - Handle: eff-momentum-boost
    EffectClass: GE_MomentumBoost
    Duration: 9.0
OwnedTags:
  - State.Alive
  - Team.Friendly
  - Role.Striker
  - Athlete.State.Fatigued
  - Team.State.HighMomentum
ReplicationMode: Mixed
bIsActive: true
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Striker (fatigued, high momentum)
  Description: Worked-example athlete showing the stamina->performance coupling and the team-momentum channel acting together
  DebugCategory: sports-pack-example
```

### Input Action Set Outfield

```yaml
# Outfield action set: the default input context for an outfield athlete in open play.
# Groups movement, on-ball, and off-ball actions into a single set that is active whenever the
# athlete is alive and not in a stoppage (cutscene/replay). Input buffering is enabled with a tight
# 0.12 s window so quick pass/skill-move sequences feel responsive without swallowing repeats - the
# same convention the shooter pack uses for its on-foot set.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_action_set.json
Name: Outfield
Actions:
  - Move
  - Look
  - Sprint
  - Pass
  - Shoot
  - Tackle
  - SkillMove
Priority: 0
ActivationTags:
  RequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  BlockedTags:
    - State.Cutscene
Exclusive: false
InputBuffer:
  Enabled: true
  BufferWindow: 0.12
  MaxBufferSize: 2
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Outfield
  Description: Default outfield input context covering movement, on-ball, and off-ball actions
```

### Input Mapping Outfield Gamepad

```yaml
# Console gamepad mapping for the Outfield action set - the standard sports-game pad layout.
# Both sticks pass through a radial dead zone; the left stick is additionally radius-normalized so
# diagonal runs match cardinal speed. Sprint is bound to the right trigger with a press threshold so
# partial pulls don't drain stamina. Pass / Shoot / Skill Move sit on the face buttons; Tackle on a
# shoulder so a defender can challenge without taking a thumb off the move stick.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_mapping.json
ActionSet: Outfield
Platform: Console
Bindings:
  - Action: Move
    Inputs:
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.LeftStick.X
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.LeftStick.Y
    Modifiers:
      - StickDeadzone
      - RadialScaling

  - Action: Look
    Inputs:
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.RightStick.X
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.RightStick.Y
    Modifiers:
      - StickDeadzone

  - Action: Sprint
    Inputs:
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.RightTrigger
    Modifiers:
      - TriggerThreshold

  - Action: Pass
    Inputs:
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.FaceLeft

  - Action: Shoot
    Inputs:
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.FaceBottom

  - Action: SkillMove
    Inputs:
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.FaceRight

  - Action: Tackle
    Inputs:
      - Device: Gamepad
        Input: Gamepad.RightShoulder
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Outfield - Gamepad
  Description: Console gamepad bindings for the outfield action set with dead zones and a sprint trigger threshold
```

### Input Modifiers

```yaml
# Reusable input modifiers for the sports genre. Referenced by name in Input Mappings and run in the
# order listed on each binding. StickDeadzone is player-configurable; the others are designer tuning
# knobs. Mirrors the shooter/racing modifier conventions.

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: StickDeadzone
Type: DeadZone
Params:
  DeadZoneShape: Radial
  InnerThreshold: 0.15
  OuterThreshold: 0.95
UserConfigurable: true
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Stick Dead Zone
  Description: Radial dead zone for analog sticks - ignores drift below 15% and saturates above 95%

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: RadialScaling
Type: RadialScaling
Params:
  MaxRadius: 1.0
UserConfigurable: false
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Radial Scaling
  Description: Normalizes stick input to a maximum radius of 1.0 so diagonal runs match cardinal speed

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: TriggerThreshold
Type: TriggerThreshold
Params:
  PressThreshold: 0.5
UserConfigurable: false
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Trigger Threshold
  Description: Analog trigger press threshold - sprint engages only past a half-pull so light touches don't drain stamina
```

### Tag Registry

```yaml
# Sports genre tag taxonomy. ADDITIVE: introduces genre-specific tags only.
# It does not redefine the core lifecycle tags (State.Alive / State.Combat / State.Dead) -
# those are referenced by the pack's entities, not declared here.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_tag.json
Tags:
  # --- Athlete states (granted by Effects; tag ownership follows responsibility) ---
  - Tag: Athlete.State.Sprinting
    Description: Athlete is sprinting; granted by GE_SprintDrain while GA_Sprint is held, draining stamina
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Athlete.State.Fatigued
    Description: Stamina has fallen below the fatigue threshold; granted by GE_Fatigue, blocks GA_Sprint and GA_SkillMove
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Athlete.State.Injured
    Description: Athlete is carrying a knock; granted by GE_Injury, suppresses physical performance
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Team states (the momentum meter swings these on) ---
  - Tag: Team.State.HighMomentum
    Description: The team is on top; granted by GE_MomentumBoost, multiplies offensive skill in the Momentum channel
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Team affiliation (target gating; reused by abilities and the shot calc) ---
  - Tag: Team.Friendly
    Description: Same side as the source; used to skip own-team targets
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Team.Hostile
    Description: Opposing side; a valid tackle/shot-pressure target
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Player roles (positional classification; tune base stats and AI behaviour) ---
  - Tag: Role.Striker
    Description: Forward; finishing and off-ball movement
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Role.Midfielder
    Description: Central player; passing range and stamina
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Role.Defender
    Description: Back-line player; tackling and strength
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Role.Goalkeeper
    Description: Last line; shot-stopping and distribution
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Ability classification ---
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Sprint
    Description: Burst-movement ability that drains stamina
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Pass
    Description: Distribute the ball to a team-mate
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Shoot
    Description: Attempt on goal
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Tackle
    Description: Challenge for the ball
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Skill
    Description: Technical dribbling/skill move
    AllowMultiple: false
```

## Genre Pack: strategy

### Ability Area Strike

```yaml
# Area strike: a caster ability that spends Energy to hit an area with Magic damage and a slow. Costs
# Energy (GE_AreaStrikeCost: a flat Energy subtraction) and goes on a cooldown (GE_AreaStrikeCooldown).
# It applies GE_AreaStrikeDamage (instant Magic damage, via ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation) and GE_Slow to
# every hostile caught in the blast via ApplyEffectToActorsInRadius — sparing Faction.Friendly. The
# reference blast is centered on the caster; picking a ground location is an engine targeting seam
# (§17.2). Energy refills over time via the periodic GE_EnergyRegen. GE_AreaStrikeCost and
# GE_AreaStrikeCooldown are trivial and referenced by name rather than shipped as files.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_ability.json
Name: GA_AreaStrike
Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Cast
    - DamageType.Magic
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  ActivationBlockedTags:
    - Unit.State.Constructing
Cost: GE_AreaStrikeCost
Cooldown: GE_AreaStrikeCooldown
Tasks:
  - Type: ApplyEffectToActorsInRadius
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_AreaStrikeDamage
      Radius: 4.0
      IgnoreTargetsWithTag: Faction.Friendly
  - Type: ApplyEffectToActorsInRadius
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_Slow
      Radius: 4.0
      IgnoreTargetsWithTag: Faction.Friendly
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Area Strike
  Description: Spend energy to blast a target area with magic damage and a slowing field
  Icon: ui/icons/area_strike.png
```

### Ability Auto Attack

```yaml
# Auto-attack: acquire the target in range and apply weapon damage. The DamageType.* AbilityTag is
# the attacker's half of the rock-paper-scissors matrix - this unit fires Siege damage, so
# ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation (inside GE_UnitDamage) looks up the Siege row against the target's
# Armor.Class.* tag. Paced by a per-attack cooldown (GE_AttackCooldown, duration = 1 / AttackSpeed)
# rather than a resource cost. Blocked while the unit is still constructing or cloaked. The
# "target within AttackRange" check is activation logic (an attribute comparison, which cannot be an
# activation tag), so ApplyEffectToTarget self-acquires the nearest in-range hostile before applying the
# damage. Affiliation (which units are Faction.Hostile to this attacker) is the engine team model's job —
# §17.2 defers affiliation to the title, which tags opponents Faction.Hostile per the registry.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_ability.json
Name: GA_AutoAttack
Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Attack
    - DamageType.Siege
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  ActivationBlockedTags:
    - Unit.State.Constructing
    - Unit.State.Cloaked
Cooldown: GE_AttackCooldown
Tasks:
  - Type: ApplyEffectToTarget
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_UnitDamage
      MaxRange: 7.0
      RequireTag: Faction.Hostile
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Auto Attack
  Description: Fire the unit's weapon at the nearest enemy within range
  Icon: ui/icons/attack.png
```

### Ability Construct Building

```yaml
# Construct building: pay the resource cost, place the structure as a site, and raise it over the
# build window. Costs Minerals (GE_BuildCost: a flat Minerals subtraction) - because an ability
# cannot activate if it cannot pay its cost, an under-resourced player simply cannot start the build,
# so no explicit "enough minerals" tag is needed. On activation it applies GE_Constructing to the new
# site (granting Unit.State.Constructing, which blocks the site's own abilities), waits the build
# window, then the state expires and the structure is live. GE_BuildCost is trivial (a flat resource
# cost) and is referenced by name rather than shipped as a file, the convention the racing/shooter
# packs use for their cost/cooldown effects.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_ability.json
Name: GA_ConstructBuilding
Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Build
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  ActivationBlockedTags:
    - Unit.State.Constructing
Cost: GE_BuildCost
Tasks:
  - Type: ApplyEffectToTarget
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_Constructing
  - Type: WaitDelay
    Params:
      Duration: 20.0
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Construct Building
  Description: Spend minerals to place a structure and build it over time
  Icon: ui/icons/build.png
```

### Ability Train Unit

```yaml
# Train unit: queue a unit at a production structure. Costs Minerals (GE_TrainCost) and goes on a
# build-time cooldown (GE_TrainCooldown) that models the production timer - the next unit cannot be
# queued until the current one finishes. The "enough supply" requirement (Supply + SupplyCost <=
# MaxSupply) is an attribute comparison evaluated in activation logic, not an activation tag.
# Blocked while the structure itself is still under construction. GE_TrainCost and GE_TrainCooldown
# are trivial (a flat resource cost and a cooldown tag) and are referenced by name rather than
# shipped as files, the convention the racing/shooter packs use.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_ability.json
Name: GA_TrainUnit
Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Train
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  ActivationBlockedTags:
    - Unit.State.Constructing
Cost: GE_TrainCost
Cooldown: GE_TrainCooldown
Tasks:
  - Type: WaitDelay
    Params:
      Duration: 15.0
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Train Unit
  Description: Spend minerals and supply to produce a unit over time
  Icon: ui/icons/train.png
```

### Attribute Set

```yaml
# Strategy unit + economy attribute set: combat stats for a single unit, the meta values the
# damage/armor Execution writes, and the commander-scoped resource economy. Extends the core
# spec's attribute model (no core attribute is redefined here). Base values describe a default
# mechanical assault unit, so the set is playable as shipped.
#
# Armor CLASS and DAMAGE TYPE are TAGS (Armor.Class.* / DamageType.*), not attributes - the
# rock-paper-scissors multiplier they select is resolved in ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation, which then
# subtracts the flat Armor attribute below.
#
# The economy resources (Minerals, Gas, Supply, MaxSupply) are "commander-scoped": in a real game
# they live on a per-player commander GC that owns no combat stats, while combat units leave them at
# base. They are grouped here so the pack ships one self-contained, playable set; the worked
# controller (a single unit) only populates the combat attributes - see gameplay_controller.yaml.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/attribute_set.json
Name: UnitStatsSet
Attributes:
  # --- Survivability (damage spills into Health once mitigation resolves; 0 is a kill) ---
  - Name: MaxHealth
    DefaultBaseValue: 150.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Maximum Health
      Description: Upper clamp on Health; raised by veterancy or hull upgrades
      UICategory: Survivability
  - Name: Health
    DefaultBaseValue: 150.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
      Max: MaxHealth
    ReplicationMode: All
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Health
      Description: Hit points; reaching 0 destroys the unit. GE_UnitDamage subtracts mitigated damage here
      UICategory: Survivability
  - Name: Armor
    DefaultBaseValue: 1.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Armor
      Description: Flat damage reduction subtracted AFTER the damage-type x armor-class multiplier; raised by GE_ArmorUpgrade
      UICategory: Survivability

  # --- Weapon (the combat "feel" stats; AttackDamage is the target of the Upgrades channel) ---
  - Name: AttackDamage
    DefaultBaseValue: 30.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Attack Damage
      Description: Fully-aggregated per-hit damage read by GE_UnitDamage (after the Upgrades channel resolves)
      UICategory: Weapon
  - Name: AttackSpeed
    DefaultBaseValue: 0.8
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Attack Speed
      Description: Attacks per second; the GA_AutoAttack cooldown (GE_AttackCooldown) is 1 / AttackSpeed
      UICategory: Weapon
  - Name: AttackRange
    DefaultBaseValue: 7.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Attack Range
      Description: Maximum engagement distance in metres; gates GA_AutoAttack activation
      UICategory: Weapon

  # --- Movement & production cost ---
  - Name: MoveSpeed
    DefaultBaseValue: 320.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Movement Speed
      Description: Ground movement speed; lowered multiplicatively by GE_Slow (Debuffs channel)
      UICategory: Movement
  - Name: SupplyCost
    DefaultBaseValue: 3.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Supply Cost
      Description: Supply this unit consumes against the commander's MaxSupply when trained
      UICategory: Production

  # --- Construction progress (Meta, driven by the build system / GE_Constructing) ---
  - Name: BuildProgress
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Meta
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
      Max: 100
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Build Progress
      Description: Construction completion 0-100; below 100 the unit is a site. A shipped unit starts complete (100)
      UICategory: Production

  # --- Commander-scoped economy (Resource; driven by periodic income + cost effects) ---
  - Name: Minerals
    DefaultBaseValue: 50.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
    ReplicationMode: OwnerOnly
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Minerals
      Description: Primary resource; raised every second by the periodic GE_MineralIncome, spent by build/train costs
      UICategory: Economy
  - Name: Gas
    DefaultBaseValue: 0.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
    ReplicationMode: OwnerOnly
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Gas
      Description: Advanced resource gated behind a refinery; spent on tech and high-tier units
      UICategory: Economy
  - Name: Energy
    DefaultBaseValue: 50.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
      Max: MaxEnergy
    ReplicationMode: OwnerOnly
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Energy
      Description: Caster resource spent by GA_AreaStrike; regenerated by the periodic GE_EnergyRegen
      UICategory: Economy
  - Name: MaxEnergy
    DefaultBaseValue: 200.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Maximum Energy
      Description: Upper clamp on Energy
      UICategory: Economy
  - Name: Supply
    DefaultBaseValue: 0.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
      Max: MaxSupply
    ReplicationMode: OwnerOnly
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Supply Used
      Description: Population in use; each trained unit adds its SupplyCost. Training is blocked at MaxSupply
      UICategory: Economy
  - Name: MaxSupply
    DefaultBaseValue: 10.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Maximum Supply
      Description: Population cap; raised by building supply structures
      UICategory: Economy

  # --- Runtime telemetry (driven by the simulation / mitigation calc) ---
  - Name: EffectiveDamage
    DefaultBaseValue: 0.0
    Category: Meta
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Effective Damage
      Description: Output of ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation after the RPS multiplier and flat armor; for telemetry/UI
      UICategory: Telemetry
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Unit Stats Set
  Description: Combat stats and mitigation telemetry for a strategy unit, plus the commander-scoped resource economy
```

### Effect Areastrike Damage

```yaml
# Area strike payload: instant Magic damage applied to every hostile in the blast, dealt by
# GA_AreaStrike. It runs the same ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation as a normal weapon hit, but the caster
# ability tags the strike DamageType.Magic, so the matrix lands its bonus on Armor.Class.Shielded
# targets and its penalty on Light/Fortified - the area weapon obeys the same rock-paper-scissors
# rules as single-target fire. Only hostiles are affected (friendly units are skipped).

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_AreaStrikeDamage
DurationPolicy: Instant
ApplicationRequiredTags:
  - Faction.Hostile
Executions:
  - CalculatorClass: ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Unit.AreaStrike
```

### Effect Armor Upgrade

```yaml
# Armor tech upgrade: the defensive counterpart to GE_WeaponUpgrade. Infinite duration; a flat
# +2 Armor per researched tier. Because Armor is subtracted AFTER the damage-type x armor-class
# multiplier in ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation, flat armor is most valuable against many small hits and
# weakest against high-multiplier siege - which keeps the rock-paper-scissors matrix meaningful even
# at full upgrades. Stacks by applying multiple instances (additive flat Add). Requires a built unit.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_ArmorUpgrade
DurationPolicy: Infinite
ApplicationRequiredTags:
  - State.Alive
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: Armor
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: 2.0
```

### Effect Constructing

```yaml
# In-progress construction state. HasDuration so it self-expires after the build window, granting
# Unit.State.Constructing for its lifetime. That tag is what blocks the structure's own abilities
# (every genre ability lists it under ActivationBlockedTags) - a half-built structure cannot attack,
# train, or cast. GA_ConstructBuilding applies this, waits the duration, then lets it expire; the
# build system raises BuildProgress from 0 to 100 over the same window. Duration mirrors a typical
# structure build time. The completion cue fires when the state ends.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_Constructing
DurationPolicy: HasDuration
Duration:
  Type: ScalableFloat
  Value: 20.0
GrantedTags:
  - Unit.State.Constructing
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Unit.ConstructionComplete
```

```yaml
# Energy regeneration: a second periodic infinite effect, applied to caster units so GA_AreaStrike
```

### Effect Mineral Income

```yaml
# Mineral income: the showcase periodic effect. Infinite duration with a 1-second Period, so the
# economy ticks +5 Minerals every second for as long as the harvester/base is active - the strategy
# pack's "resource over time" engine. Applied to the commander GC (which owns the economy
# resources), one active instance per working harvester. ExecuteOnApplication is false so the first
# payout lands one full second after the harvester starts, not instantly.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
```

### Effect Slow

```yaml
# Slow field: the tower-defense-flavoured debuff GA_AreaStrike (or a slow tower) drops on enemies.
# HasDuration so it wears off; a Multiply of -0.4 on MoveSpeed in the "Debuffs" channel
# (factor 1 - 0.4 = 0.60, i.e. 40% slower). Because it sits in its own channel it multiplies cleanly
# against any movement Upgrades a unit carries, instead of fighting them additively. Grants
# Unit.State.Slowed for cues and stacking rules. Targets must be hostile.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_Slow
DurationPolicy: HasDuration
Duration:
  Type: ScalableFloat
  Value: 4.0
ApplicationRequiredTags:
  - Faction.Hostile
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: MoveSpeed
    Operation: Multiply
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -0.4
    Channel: Debuffs
GrantedTags:
  - Unit.State.Slowed
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Unit.Slowed
```

### Effect Unit Damage

```yaml
# Weapon hit, applied to the target unit by GA_AutoAttack. Strategy damage is not a single
# subtraction: it couples the attacker's aggregated AttackDamage with the rock-paper-scissors
# DAMAGE-TYPE x ARMOR-CLASS matrix (the attacker's DamageType.* tag vs the target's Armor.Class.*
# tag) and only then subtracts the target's flat Armor - so it runs through a custom Execution.
# ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation reads both tag sets, applies the matrix multiplier, subtracts Armor
# (flooring at a small chip value so a hit is never fully negated), writes the result to Health and
# records it in the EffectiveDamage Meta attribute for telemetry/UI. This is the strategy analogue
# of the shooter's hit-resolution calc and the racing pack's traction calc - the seam where the
# genre's signature math plugs into UGAS.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_UnitDamage
DurationPolicy: Instant
Executions:
  - CalculatorClass: ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Unit.WeaponImpact
```

### Effect Weapon Upgrade

```yaml
# Weapon tech upgrade: a permanent, faction-wide research bonus. Infinite duration; a Multiply of
# +0.15 in the "Upgrades" channel of the modifier pipeline. Researching the same tech multiple
# times stacks DECLARATIVELY - two active instances add their bonuses WITHIN the channel
# (+0.15 + 0.15 = +0.30 -> effective factor 1.30), so no custom code is needed for upgrade tiers.
# The Upgrades channel multiplies against any other channel (e.g. Debuffs), exactly the
# damage-bucket mechanism from the core spec, reused for tech. Requires a built unit.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_WeaponUpgrade
DurationPolicy: Infinite
ApplicationRequiredTags:
  - State.Alive
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: AttackDamage
    Operation: Multiply
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: 0.15
    Channel: Upgrades
```

### Gameplay Controller

```yaml
# Worked example: a Siege Tank (Unit.Type.Vehicle, Armor.Class.Heavy) with two ranks of the weapon
# upgrade and one rank of the armor upgrade researched. CurrentValue columns show the result of the
# three active infinite effects below. The AttackDamage aggregation is the genre's tech-channel
# signature: two GE_WeaponUpgrade instances stack ADDITIVELY WITHIN the Upgrades channel.
#   AttackDamage: base 30 x Upgrades(1 + 0.15 + 0.15 = 1.30)        = 39.0
#   Armor:        base 1  + ArmorUpgrade(+2)                        = 3.0
# Everything else is at base (no other effect touches it). The economy attributes (Minerals, Gas,
# Supply, ...) belong to the player's commander GC, not a combat unit, so they stay at base here.
#
# The damage matrix worked example in spec.adoc fires THIS tank's Siege attack (AttackDamage 39) at a
# Light infantry target (Siege vs Light = 1.25, target Armor 2): 39 x 1.25 - 2 = 46.75 final damage.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_controller.json
OwnerActor:
  ActorID: Unit_SiegeTank_01
  ActorType: PlayerUnit
AttributeSets:
  - Name: UnitStatsSet
    Attributes:
      - Name: MaxHealth
        BaseValue: 150.0
        CurrentValue: 150.0
      - Name: Health
        BaseValue: 150.0
        CurrentValue: 150.0
      - Name: Armor
        BaseValue: 1.0
        CurrentValue: 3.0
      - Name: AttackDamage
        BaseValue: 30.0
        CurrentValue: 39.0
      - Name: AttackSpeed
        BaseValue: 0.8
        CurrentValue: 0.8
      - Name: AttackRange
        BaseValue: 7.0
        CurrentValue: 7.0
      - Name: MoveSpeed
        BaseValue: 320.0
        CurrentValue: 320.0
      - Name: SupplyCost
        BaseValue: 3.0
        CurrentValue: 3.0
      - Name: BuildProgress
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: Energy
        BaseValue: 50.0
        CurrentValue: 50.0
      - Name: MaxEnergy
        BaseValue: 200.0
        CurrentValue: 200.0
GrantedAbilities:
  - AbilityClass: GA_AutoAttack
    Level: 1
    InputID: AttackMove

ActiveEffects:

  - State.Alive

bIsActive: true

  DisplayName: Siege Tank (2x weapon upgrade, 1x armor upgrade)
  Description: Worked-example unit showing tech-upgrade channel aggregation on AttackDamage and the damage matrix attacker
  DebugCategory: strategy-pack-example
```

### Input Action Set Command

```yaml
# Command action set: the default input context for an RTS player issuing orders. Groups the
# selection, order, production, cast, and camera actions into one set that is active whenever the
# player is alive and not in a cutscene. Input buffering is enabled with a short window so that
# rapid build/train hotkey sequences register without swallowing repeats.

Name: Command
Actions:
  - Select
  - AttackMove
  - Build
  - Train
  - CastAbility
  - CameraPan
Priority: 0
ActivationTags:
  RequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  BlockedTags:
    - State.Cutscene
Exclusive: false
InputBuffer:
  Enabled: true
  BufferWindow: 0.15
  MaxBufferSize: 3
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Command
  Description: Default RTS command context covering selection, orders, production, casting, and camera
```

### Input Actions

```yaml
# Strategy genre input actions. Each document defines a single action that an ability or the
# selection/camera system listens for. Actions are grouped into an Action Set (see

# CameraPan is a continuous 2D vector for edge/keyboard scrolling.
```

### Input Mapping Command Pc

```yaml
# PC keyboard + mouse mapping for the Command action set - the canonical RTS scheme.
# Select is left-click; the contextual Move/Attack-Move order is right-click; Build/Train/Cast are
# hotkeys (B / T / Q); CameraPan uses a WASD composite with an EdgePanScaling modifier so screen-edge
# and keyboard scrolling share one tuned response. The order and camera bindings are non-rebindable
# anchors of the scheme; the hotkeys remain rebindable.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_mapping.json
ActionSet: Command
Platform: PC
Bindings:
  - Action: Select
    Inputs:
      - Device: Mouse
        Input: Mouse.LeftButton
    bIsRebindable: false

  - Action: AttackMove
    Inputs:
      - Device: Mouse
        Input: Mouse.RightButton
    bIsRebindable: false

  - Action: Build
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.B

  - Action: Train
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.T

  - Action: CastAbility
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.Q

  - Action: CameraPan
    CompositeInputs:
      Up:
        Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.W
      Down:
        Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.S
      Left:
        Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.A
      Right:
        Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.D
    Modifiers:
      - EdgePanScaling
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Command - PC
  Description: Keyboard and mouse bindings for the RTS command action set
```

### Tag Registry

```yaml
# Strategy genre tag taxonomy. ADDITIVE: introduces genre-specific tags only.
# It does NOT redefine the core lifecycle tags (State.Alive / State.Dead) - those are referenced by
# the pack's entities (e.g. the worked controller's OwnedTags), not declared here.
#
# Two tag families drive the signature mechanic and never become attributes:
#   - DamageType.* : carried by the attacker (its weapon), read by ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation.
#   - Armor.Class.*: carried by the target, read by the same calc to pick the RPS multiplier.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_tag.json
Tags:
  # --- Unit type / role (set on the unit by its production effect; used for bulk queries) ---
  - Tag: Unit.Type.Infantry
    Description: Foot soldier; typically Armor.Class.Light
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Unit.Type.Vehicle
    Description: Ground vehicle; typically Armor.Class.Heavy
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Unit.Type.Air
    Description: Flying unit; typically Armor.Class.Light and only hit by anti-air weapons
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Unit.Type.Structure
    Description: Building; typically Armor.Class.Fortified, immobile
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Armor classes (target side of the damage matrix; selected by ExecCalc_ArmorMitigation) ---
  - Tag: Armor.Class.Light
    Description: Light armour; extra damage from Piercing, slightly less from Magic
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Armor.Class.Heavy
    Description: Heavy armour; resists Siege, neutral to most other damage
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Armor.Class.Fortified
    Description: Fortified structure armour; takes bonus Siege but resists Normal/Piercing/Magic
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Armor.Class.Shielded
    Description: Energy-shielded armour; weak to Magic, resists Siege and Piercing
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Damage types (attacker side of the matrix; carried by the weapon / GA_AutoAttack) ---
  - Tag: DamageType.Normal
    Description: Standard kinetic damage; no strong matchups, never penalised
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: DamageType.Piercing
    Description: Armour-piercing rounds; strong vs Light, weak vs Fortified
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: DamageType.Siege
    Description: Explosive siege damage; strong vs Fortified, weak vs Heavy/Shielded
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: DamageType.Magic
    Description: Energy/spell damage; strong vs Shielded, weak vs Light/Fortified
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Unit dynamic states (granted by Effects; never written directly by abilities) ---
  - Tag: Unit.State.Constructing
    Description: Unit/structure is under construction; granted by GE_Constructing, blocks its abilities
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Unit.State.Slowed
    Description: Movement is reduced by a slow field; granted by GE_Slow
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Unit.State.Cloaked
    Description: Unit is cloaked and untargetable by normal attacks
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Ability classification ---
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Attack
    Description: Weapon attack ability (GA_AutoAttack)
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Build
    Description: Construction ability that places a structure (GA_ConstructBuilding)
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Train
    Description: Production ability that queues a unit (GA_TrainUnit)
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Cast
    Description: Caster ability that spends Energy for an effect (GA_AreaStrike)
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Faction (relationship gating for targeting and area effects) ---
  - Tag: Faction.Friendly
    Description: Same faction as the source; skipped by hostile-only area effects
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Faction.Hostile
    Description: Opposing faction; a valid attack/area-strike target
    AllowMultiple: false
```

## Genre Pack: survival-crafting

### Ability Build

```yaml
# Build: spend materials to place a structure (wall, shelter, campfire). Like GA_Craft, the Cost
# (GE_BuildCost: Materials -10) gates the ability on having enough materials. A short placement wait,
# then the structure is spawned by the engine - the actual spawn is engine logic keyed off the
# ability completing, since placing a world actor is outside the attribute/effect model. Sheltering
# structures are what let a survivor earn Survival.State.Sheltered and escape cold exposure.
# GE_BuildCost is a trivial flat resource cost referenced by name, not shipped as a file.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_ability.json
Name: GA_Build
Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Build
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  ActivationBlockedTags:
    - Survival.State.Gathering
    - Survival.State.Crafting
Cost: GE_BuildCost
Tasks:
  - Type: WaitDelay
    Params:
      Duration: 2.0
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Build
  Description: Place a structure from carried materials
  Icon: ui/icons/build.png
```

### Ability Consume Food

```yaml
# Consume food: eat a carried food item to restore Hunger. Requires a food item in the inventory
# (Item.Type.Food) and that the survivor is alive. A short eat wait, then the instant GE_EatFood
# tops up Hunger - which is what lifts Hunger off 0 and lets the engine clear Survival.State.Starving.
# Blocked while crafting. A full game would also decrement the specific food item from inventory;
# here the restore is the modelled effect.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_ability.json
Name: GA_ConsumeFood
Tags:
  AbilityTags:
    - Ability.Type.Consume
  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
    - Item.Type.Food
  ActivationBlockedTags:
    - Survival.State.Crafting
Tasks:
  - Type: WaitDelay
    Params:
      Duration: 1.5
  - Type: ApplyEffectToOwner
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_EatFood
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Eat Food
  Description: Eat a carried food item to restore satiation
  Icon: ui/icons/eat.png
```

### Ability Craft

```yaml
# Craft: spend materials to produce a tool. Because an ability cannot activate if it cannot pay its
# Cost, GE_CraftCost (Materials -20) is exactly what gates crafting on having enough materials - no
# explicit resource-check tag is needed, the same convention the shooter pack uses for GE_FireCost.
# On activation it enters the crafting state (GE_Crafting grants Survival.State.Crafting), waits the
# craft window, then applies the crafted item's effect (GE_CraftedTool). Blocked while gathering or
# already crafting. GE_CraftCost is a trivial flat resource cost referenced by name, not shipped as a file.

  ActivationRequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  ActivationBlockedTags:
    - Survival.State.Gathering
    - Survival.State.Crafting
  ActivationOwnedTags:
    - Survival.State.Crafting

Tasks:
  - Type: ApplyEffectToOwner
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_Crafting
  - Type: WaitDelay
    Params:
      Duration: 3.0
  - Type: ApplyEffectToOwner
    Params:
      EffectClass: GE_CraftedTool
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Craft
  Description: Spend materials at a workbench to craft a tool
  Icon: ui/icons/craft.png
```

### Ability Sprint

```yaml
# Sprint: hold to run faster while draining Stamina. Same hold-then-WaitInputRelease shape as the
```

### Attribute Set

```yaml
# Survivor vitals attribute set: the survival needs (hunger, thirst, stamina), the body-temperature
# comfort window, survivability, and the encumbrance economy. Extends the core spec's attribute
# model (no core attribute is redefined here). Base values describe a rested, fed survivor at a
# comfortable temperature carrying nothing, so the set is playable as shipped: every need starts
# full and the needs-decay loop (GE_HungerDecay / GE_ThirstDecay) drains them from there.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/attribute_set.json
Name: SurvivorVitalsSet
Attributes:
  # --- Survivability (Health is the sink the cascading threshold penalties drain) ---
  - Name: MaxHealth
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Maximum Health
      UICategory: Survivability
  - Name: Health
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
      Max: MaxHealth
    ReplicationMode: All
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Health
      Description: Hit points; reaching 0 is death. Drained by starvation, dehydration, and cold exposure
      UICategory: Survivability

  # --- Needs (drain over time via periodic infinite effects; bottoming out triggers a penalty) ---
  - Name: MaxHunger
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Maximum Hunger
      UICategory: Needs
  - Name: Hunger
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
      Max: MaxHunger
    ReplicationMode: All
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Satiation
      Description: Fullness; drained by GE_HungerDecay. At 0 the engine grants Survival.State.Starving and applies GE_Starvation
      UICategory: Needs
  - Name: MaxThirst
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Maximum Thirst
      UICategory: Needs
  - Name: Thirst
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
      Max: MaxThirst
    ReplicationMode: All
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Hydration
      Description: Hydration; drained by GE_ThirstDecay. At 0 the engine grants Survival.State.Dehydrated and applies GE_Dehydration
      UICategory: Needs
  - Name: MaxStamina
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Maximum Stamina
      UICategory: Needs
  - Name: Stamina
    DefaultBaseValue: 100.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
      Max: MaxStamina
    ReplicationMode: All
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Stamina
      Description: Exertion pool; spent by GA_Sprint, regenerated by GE_StaminaRegen while not sprinting. At 0 the engine grants Survival.State.Exhausted
      UICategory: Needs

  # --- Body temperature (clamped to a survivable range with a comfort window, like the racing
  #     pack's TireTemperature). Pushed by exposure effects; outside the window grants a state) ---
  - Name: BodyTemperature
    DefaultBaseValue: 37.0
    Category: Statistic
    Clamping:
      Min: 25.0
      Max: 43.0
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Body Temperature
      Description: Core temperature in degrees C, clamped to the survivable [25, 43]. The comfort window is 36-38; below it the engine grants Survival.State.Cold, above it Survival.State.Hot
      UICategory: Vitals

  # --- Movement (lowered by encumbrance and the exhausted/cold states) ---
  - Name: MoveSpeed
    DefaultBaseValue: 300.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Movement Speed
      Description: Ground movement speed; reduced by GE_Overencumbered (Encumbrance channel) while CarryWeight exceeds MaxCarryWeight
      UICategory: Movement

  # --- Encumbrance economy (gathering fills CarryWeight; over the limit triggers a penalty) ---
  - Name: MaxCarryWeight
    DefaultBaseValue: 50.0
    Category: Statistic
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Carry Capacity
      Description: Inventory weight limit in kg; when CarryWeight exceeds it the engine grants Survival.State.Overencumbered
      UICategory: Inventory
  - Name: CarryWeight
    DefaultBaseValue: 0.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
    ReplicationMode: OwnerOnly
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Carried Weight
      Description: Current inventory weight in kg; raised by GE_GatherResource, lowered by crafting and dropping
      UICategory: Inventory

  # --- Crafting / gathering economy (a generic harvested-material resource) ---
  - Name: Materials
    DefaultBaseValue: 0.0
    Category: Resource
    Clamping:
      Min: 0
    ReplicationMode: OwnerOnly
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Materials
      Description: Generic crafting materials harvested by GA_Gather and spent by GA_Craft / GA_Build
      UICategory: Inventory

  # --- Runtime telemetry (written each tick by the survival simulation / ExecCalc_SurvivalTick) ---
  - Name: WarmthRating
    DefaultBaseValue: 0.0
    Category: Meta
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Warmth Rating
      Description: Aggregated insulation from clothing/shelter (Warmth channel); offsets cold exposure each tick
      UICategory: Telemetry
  - Name: VitalsDrainRate
    DefaultBaseValue: 0.0
    Category: Meta
    Metadata:
      DisplayName: Vitals Drain Rate
      Description: Output of ExecCalc_SurvivalTick; the combined Health delta per tick from starvation, dehydration, and exposure
      UICategory: Telemetry
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Survivor Vitals Set
  Description: Survival needs (hunger, thirst, stamina), body-temperature comfort window, survivability, and the encumbrance/crafting economy for a survival-crafting character
```

```yaml
# Dehydration: the cascading threshold penalty for thirst, mirroring GE_Starvation. The engine
```

### Effect Exhaustion

```yaml
# Exhaustion: the stamina threshold state. The engine's threshold detector applies this (granting
# Survival.State.Exhausted) when Stamina reaches 0, and removes it once Stamina regenerates above a
# recovery margin. INFINITE while exhausted. It carries no attribute drain - it is purely a gating
# state: GA_Sprint lists Survival.State.Exhausted in ActivationBlockedTags, so an exhausted survivor
# simply cannot sprint until they have recovered. This shows a threshold cascade whose payload is a
# capability lock rather than a Health drain.
```

### Effect Exposure Cold

```yaml
# Cold exposure: a snow-biome / night area effect that pushes BodyTemperature DOWN, out of the
# comfort window. INFINITE + PERIOD while the survivor is exposed (applied/removed by the biome's
# area volume). Each tick it subtracts from BodyTemperature, which is clamped to the survivable
# [25, 43]. It grants Survival.State.Cold so abilities and cues can react. Insulation (clothing,
# shelter, a campfire) counters it by adding warmth in the Warmth channel and via Survival.State.Sheltered.
# Once BodyTemperature sits below the comfort window, the engine keeps Survival.State.Cold applied and
# the cold becomes a Health drain through GE_Hypothermia.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_Exposure_Cold
DurationPolicy: Infinite
Period:
  Period: 1.0
  ExecuteOnApplication: false
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: BodyTemperature
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -0.4
GrantedTags:
  - Survival.State.Cold
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Survival.Shivering
```

### Effect Exposure Heat

```yaml
# Heat exposure: the desert-biome / midday mirror of GE_Exposure_Cold. INFINITE + PERIOD while the
# survivor is exposed (applied/removed by the biome's area volume); each tick it pushes
# BodyTemperature UP toward the survivable ceiling of 43 (clamped by core spec 5.4). It grants
# Survival.State.Hot once temperature climbs above the 36-38 comfort window. Shade, water, and
# lighter clothing counter it. The hot-side Health drain (heatstroke) is the symmetric counterpart
# to GE_Hypothermia and would be applied by the same temperature-window detector on the high side.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json

  Period: 1.0

    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: 0.4

  - Survival.State.Hot
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Survival.Overheating
```

```yaml
# Harvest payload: an INSTANT effect applied at the end of the gather wait. It adds raw materials to
```

### Effect Hunger Decay

```yaml
# Hunger decay: the core of the survival needs loop. An INFINITE effect with a PERIOD that
# subtracts a flat amount of Hunger every tick - the canonical periodic effect (cf. core spec

# detector grants Survival.State.Starving and applies GE_Starvation (see the spec's signature section).
```

### Effect Hypothermia

```yaml
# Hypothermia: the cascading threshold penalty for the cold side of the temperature window. The
# engine's temperature-window detector applies this (and it keeps Survival.State.Cold) once
# BodyTemperature falls below the comfort window's lower bound (36 C), and removes it when the
# survivor warms back into the window. INFINITE + PERIOD: it drains Health each tick AND slows the
# survivor (a -25% MoveSpeed multiply in the Cold channel - stumbling in the cold). The temperature
# PUSH is GE_Exposure_Cold's job; this effect is the consequence of being OUT of the window, exactly
# the "temp out of window -> grant state + drain" cascade documented in the signature section.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_Hypothermia
DurationPolicy: Infinite
Period:
  Period: 1.0
  ExecuteOnApplication: true
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: Health
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -1.0
  - Attribute: MoveSpeed
    Operation: Multiply
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -0.25
    Channel: Cold
GrantedTags:
  - Survival.State.Cold
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Survival.Hypothermia
```

### Effect Overencumbered

```yaml
# Overencumbered: the encumbrance threshold penalty. The engine's weight detector applies this
# (and it grants Survival.State.Overencumbered) when CarryWeight exceeds MaxCarryWeight, and removes
# it once the survivor drops or crafts enough to get back under the limit. INFINITE while over the
# limit. It cuts MoveSpeed by 40% in the Encumbrance channel - a different channel from cold's Cold
# channel, so an overencumbered AND cold survivor multiplies the two factors (see the worked example
# in gameplay_controller.yaml). The "CarryWeight > MaxCarryWeight" comparison is engine logic; the
# MoveSpeed cut is pure data.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_Overencumbered
DurationPolicy: Infinite
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: MoveSpeed
    Operation: Multiply
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -0.40
    Channel: Encumbrance
GrantedTags:
  - Survival.State.Overencumbered
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Survival.Overencumbered
```

### Effect Sprinting

```yaml
# Sprinting: a HasDuration + PERIOD effect that drains Stamina every tick while GA_Sprint holds it
# (the ability refreshes it each tick and removes it on input release). Like the racing pack's
# GE_DriftCharge it carries a single periodic modifier so every tick reads as a clean instant
# Stamina subtraction (core spec 9.3). Its -3/tick drain outpaces the always-on +5/tick
# GE_StaminaRegen while held, so net Stamina FALLS during a sprint and recovers when it ends. Grants
# Survival.State.Sprinting (the movement system reads this tag to raise the sprint speed). When
# Stamina reaches 0 the engine grants Survival.State.Exhausted (GE_Exhaustion), which blocks GA_Sprint.

  Type: ScalableFloat
  Value: 1.0

  Period: 1.0
  ExecuteOnApplication: true
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: Stamina
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -3.0
GrantedTags:
  - Survival.State.Sprinting
```

### Effect Stamina Regen

```yaml
# Stamina regen: an always-on INFINITE + PERIOD effect that restores Stamina every tick.
# There is no ApplicationRequiredTags gate; the effect runs unconditionally. While sprinting,
# GE_SprintDrain applies a faster opposing drain (-3/tick) that outpaces this regen (+5/tick
# less the drain), so net stamina falls during a sprint and recovers once the sprint ends.
```

### Effect Starvation

```yaml
# Starvation: the cascading threshold penalty for hunger. The engine's threshold detector applies
# this effect (and it grants Survival.State.Starving) when Hunger reaches 0; it removes it when
# Hunger climbs back above 0 after the survivor eats. INFINITE + PERIOD so it keeps draining Health
# every tick for as long as the survivor starves. This is the "need bottoms out -> drains Health"
# cascade described in the signature section; the detection is engine logic, the drain is pure data.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json

  Period: 1.0

  - Attribute: Health
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -2.0
GrantedTags:
  - Survival.State.Starving
GameplayCues:
  - GameplayCue.Survival.Starving
```

### Effect Survival Tick

```yaml
# Survival tick: the OPTIONAL aggregated-penalty seam. Instead of stacking three independent periodic
# Health drains (GE_Starvation + GE_Dehydration + GE_Hypothermia), a game can run ONE periodic effect
# whose Execution couples the combined deficits - how far each need is below its threshold and how far
# BodyTemperature is outside the comfort window, offset by WarmthRating - into a single Health delta,
# writing VitalsDrainRate (Meta) for the UI. This is the survival analogue of the racing pack's
# ExecCalc_VehicleTraction and the shooter pack's ExecCalc_HitResolution: the seam where a genre's
# signature math plugs into UGAS. INFINITE + PERIOD; ExecuteOnApplication so the first tick lands at spawn.
# Use EITHER this single calc OR the individual GE_Starvation/GE_Dehydration/GE_Hypothermia drains.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_SurvivalTick
DurationPolicy: Infinite
Period:
  Period: 1.0
  ExecuteOnApplication: true
Executions:
  - CalculatorClass: ExecCalc_SurvivalTick
```

### Effect Thirst Decay

```yaml
# Thirst decay: the second pillar of the needs loop. INFINITE + PERIOD, draining Thirst faster
# than Hunger (people dehydrate before they starve). Applied at spawn and never removed. When
# Thirst reaches the [0, MaxThirst] clamp floor, the engine grants Survival.State.Dehydrated and
# applies GE_Dehydration. Hot biomes layer an extra thirst drain on top via their own area effect.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_effect.json
Name: GE_ThirstDecay
DurationPolicy: Infinite
Period:
  Period: 1.0
  ExecuteOnApplication: false
Modifiers:
  - Attribute: Thirst
    Operation: Add
    Magnitude:
      Type: ScalableFloat
      Value: -0.8
```

### Gameplay Controller

```yaml
# Worked example: a survivor caught out at night in a snow biome - cold AND starving AND
# overencumbered. It shows both halves of the signature mechanic at once: the cascading Health
# drains (engine-detected thresholds), and a two-channel MoveSpeed penalty (the modifier pipeline).
#
# Periodic effects modify BASE VALUES over time (core spec 5.2 / 9.3), so the resource pools below
# are snapshots mid-event; the Statistic MoveSpeed is the CurrentValue from the active multiply
# channels. The active effects and their per-tick deltas:
#   Hunger hit 0           -> engine grants Survival.State.Starving + GE_Starvation  (Health -2/tick)
#   BodyTemperature < 36   -> engine grants Survival.State.Cold     + GE_Hypothermia (Health -1/tick)
#   CarryWeight 65 > Max 50 -> engine grants Survival.State.Overencumbered + GE_Overencumbered
#
#   Health drain/tick:  Starvation(-2) + Hypothermia(-1)                         = -3.0  (VitalsDrainRate)
#   MoveSpeed:          base 300 x Encumbrance(1 - 0.40 = 0.60) x Cold(1 - 0.25 = 0.75) = 135.0
#   BodyTemperature:    GE_Exposure_Cold (periodic Add -0.4/tick) drove the BASE VALUE down to 34.0 (clamp [25,43])
# GE_HungerDecay / GE_ThirstDecay / GE_StaminaRegen are the always-on needs loop that got the
# survivor here (Hunger drained to 0, Thirst down to 30, Stamina recovered to full while not sprinting).

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_controller.json
OwnerActor:
  ActorID: Survivor_01
  ActorType: PlayerCharacter
AttributeSets:
  - Name: SurvivorVitalsSet
    Attributes:
      - Name: MaxHealth
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: Health
        BaseValue: 40.0
        CurrentValue: 40.0
      - Name: MaxHunger
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: Hunger
        BaseValue: 0.0
        CurrentValue: 0.0
      - Name: MaxThirst
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: Thirst
        BaseValue: 30.0
        CurrentValue: 30.0
      - Name: MaxStamina
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: Stamina
        BaseValue: 100.0
        CurrentValue: 100.0
      - Name: BodyTemperature
        BaseValue: 34.0
        CurrentValue: 34.0
      - Name: MoveSpeed
        BaseValue: 300.0
        CurrentValue: 135.0
      - Name: MaxCarryWeight
        BaseValue: 50.0
        CurrentValue: 50.0
      - Name: CarryWeight
        BaseValue: 65.0
        CurrentValue: 65.0
      - Name: Materials
        BaseValue: 0.0
        CurrentValue: 12.0
      - Name: WarmthRating
        BaseValue: 0.0
        CurrentValue: 0.0
      - Name: VitalsDrainRate
        BaseValue: 0.0
        CurrentValue: -3.0
GrantedAbilities:
  - AbilityClass: GA_Gather
    Level: 1
    InputID: Gather
  - AbilityClass: GA_Craft
    Level: 1
    InputID: Craft
  - AbilityClass: GA_Build
    Level: 1
    InputID: Build
  - AbilityClass: GA_ConsumeFood
    Level: 1
    InputID: ConsumeFood
  - AbilityClass: GA_Drink
    Level: 1
    InputID: Drink
  - AbilityClass: GA_Sprint
    Level: 1
    InputID: Sprint
ActiveEffects:
  - Handle: eff-hunger-decay
    EffectClass: GE_HungerDecay
    Duration: -1
  - Handle: eff-thirst-decay
    EffectClass: GE_ThirstDecay
    Duration: -1
  - Handle: eff-stamina-regen
    EffectClass: GE_StaminaRegen
    Duration: -1
  - Handle: eff-starvation
    EffectClass: GE_Starvation
    Duration: -1
  - Handle: eff-exposure-cold
    EffectClass: GE_Exposure_Cold
    Duration: -1
  - Handle: eff-hypothermia
    EffectClass: GE_Hypothermia
    Duration: -1
  - Handle: eff-overencumbered
    EffectClass: GE_Overencumbered
    Duration: -1
OwnedTags:
  - State.Alive
  - Survival.State.Starving
  - Survival.State.Cold
  - Survival.State.Overencumbered
  - Biome.Snow
  - Environment.TimeOfDay.Night
ReplicationMode: Mixed
bIsActive: true
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Survivor (night, cold + starving + overencumbered)
  Description: Worked-example survivor showing cascading Health drains and two-channel MoveSpeed reduction
  DebugCategory: survival-crafting-pack-example
```

### Input Action Set Survival

```yaml
# Survival action set: the default input context for a survivor in the world. Groups movement and
# the survival/crafting actions into one set that is active whenever the player is alive and not in a
# menu or cutscene. Input buffering is enabled with a short window so a queued Gather or Eat fires as
# soon as the previous activity wait ends, without swallowing repeats.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_action_set.json
Name: SurvivalOnFoot
Actions:
  - Move
  - Look
  - Jump
  - Sprint
  - Gather
  - Craft
  - Build
  - ConsumeFood
  - Drink
Priority: 0
ActivationTags:
  RequiredTags:
    - State.Alive
  BlockedTags:
    - State.Dead
Exclusive: false
InputBuffer:
  Enabled: true
  BufferWindow: 0.15
  MaxBufferSize: 2
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Survival On Foot
  Description: Default on-foot input context covering movement, gathering, crafting, building, and consuming
```

### Input Actions

```yaml
# Survival / Crafting genre input actions. Each document defines a single action that an ability or
# movement system listens for. Actions are grouped into Action Sets (see input_action_set_survival.yaml)
# and bound to hardware in Input Mappings. The action Names are the InputIDs the GrantedAbilities in
# gameplay_controller.yaml reference (Gather -> GA_Gather, Sprint -> GA_Sprint, etc.).

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_action.json

ValueType: Axis2D
TriggerBehavior: WhileHeld
ConsumeInput: true
Tags:

  DisplayName: Move
  Description: Omnidirectional ground movement
  Icon: ui/icons/move.png
```
