### Input Mapping Survival Pc

```yaml
# PC keyboard + mouse mapping for the SurvivalOnFoot action set. Move uses a WASD composite; Look
# uses raw mouse axes with a MouseSensitivity modifier. Gather/Interact is a hold-to-harvest on E
# (HoldThreshold distinguishes a quick interact tap from a sustained gather); Eat and Drink sit on
# the number row; Craft and Build open their respective modes.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_mapping.json
ActionSet: SurvivalOnFoot
Platform: PC
Bindings:
  - Action: Move
    CompositeInputs:
      Up:
        Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.W
      Down:
        Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.S
      Left:
        Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.A
      Right:
        Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.D

  - Action: Look
    Inputs:
      - Device: Mouse
        Input: Mouse.Axis.X
      - Device: Mouse
        Input: Mouse.Axis.Y
    Modifiers:
      - MouseSensitivity

  - Action: Jump
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.Space

  - Action: Sprint
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.LeftShift

  - Action: Gather
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.E
    HoldThreshold: 0.25

  - Action: Craft
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.C

  - Action: Build
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.B

  - Action: ConsumeFood
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.1

  - Action: Drink
    Inputs:
      - Device: Keyboard
        Input: Key.2
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Survival On Foot - PC
  Description: Keyboard and mouse bindings for the survival on-foot action set
```

### Input Modifiers

```yaml
# Reusable input modifiers for the survival genre. Referenced by name in Input Mappings. They sit in
# the per-binding modifier pipeline and run in the order listed on each binding. MouseSensitivity is
# player-configurable (exposed in the settings screen); StickDeadzone cleans up analog stick drift
# for a future gamepad mapping; MovementNormalize keeps diagonal WASD/stick movement at unit speed.

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: MouseSensitivity
Type: Sensitivity
Params:
  Multiplier: 1.0
  MultiplierX: 1.0
  MultiplierY: 1.0
UserConfigurable: true
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Mouse Sensitivity
  Description: Per-axis mouse sensitivity multiplier exposed in the player settings screen

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: StickDeadzone
Type: DeadZone
Params:
  DeadZoneShape: Radial
  InnerThreshold: 0.15
  OuterThreshold: 0.95
UserConfigurable: true
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Stick Dead Zone
  Description: Radial dead zone for analog sticks - ignores drift below 15% and saturates above 95%

---
$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/input_modifier.json
Name: MovementNormalize
Type: Normalize
Params:
  MaxRadius: 1.0
UserConfigurable: false
Metadata:
  DisplayName: Movement Normalize
  Description: Normalizes the movement vector so diagonal input is not faster than cardinal input
```

### Tag Registry

```yaml
# Survival / Crafting genre tag taxonomy. ADDITIVE: introduces genre-specific tags only.
# It does not redefine the core lifecycle tags (State.Alive / State.Dead) - those are referenced
# by the pack's entities (e.g. the worked controller's OwnedTags), not declared here.
# Every survival state below is GRANTED BY AN EFFECT, never written directly by an ability.

$schema: https://ugas.jbltx.com/v1.0.0-draft.5/schemas/gameplay_tag.json
Tags:
  # --- Survival states (granted by the cascading threshold effects; gate abilities and cues) ---
  - Tag: Survival.State.Starving
    Description: Hunger has bottomed out; granted by GE_Starvation, which drains Health each tick
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Survival.State.Dehydrated
    Description: Thirst has bottomed out; granted by GE_Dehydration, which drains Health each tick
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Survival.State.Exhausted
    Description: Stamina has bottomed out; granted by GE_Exhaustion, blocks sprinting until stamina recovers
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Survival.State.Cold
    Description: Body temperature fell below the comfort window; granted by GE_Exposure_Cold
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Survival.State.Hot
    Description: Body temperature rose above the comfort window; granted by GE_Exposure_Heat
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Survival.State.Overencumbered
    Description: CarryWeight exceeds MaxCarryWeight; granted by GE_Overencumbered, which slows movement
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Survival.State.Sheltered
    Description: Inside shelter / near a heat source; suppresses cold exposure and speeds stamina regen
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Activity states (granted by activity effects while a gather/craft wait is in progress) ---
  - Tag: Survival.State.Gathering
    Description: A harvest is in progress; granted by GE_Gathering for the duration of the gather wait
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Survival.State.Crafting
    Description: A craft is in progress; granted by GE_Crafting for the duration of the craft wait
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Survival.State.Sprinting
    Description: Sprinting; granted by GE_Sprinting while GA_Sprint is held, draining stamina
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Item / resource classification (carried inventory; gate consume/craft abilities) ---
  - Tag: Item.Type.Food
    Description: Edible item; consumed by GA_ConsumeFood to restore Hunger
    AllowMultiple: true
  - Tag: Item.Type.Water
    Description: Drinkable item; consumed by GA_Drink to restore Thirst
    AllowMultiple: true
  - Tag: Item.Type.Material
    Description: Raw crafting material gathered from a resource node
    AllowMultiple: true
    DevComment: Extension point for typed crafting materials (e.g. Item.Type.Material.Wood, Item.Type.Material.Stone); gate craft recipes on sub-tags when the pack is extended
  - Tag: Item.Type.Tool
    Description: A crafted tool; equipping it grants a gathering/crafting buff (GE_CraftedTool)
    AllowMultiple: true

  # --- Ability classification ---
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Gather
    Description: Harvests resources from a node into the inventory
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Craft
    Description: Spends materials to produce a tool, structure, or consumable
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Consume
    Description: Consumes a carried item to restore a need
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Build
    Description: Places a structure, spending materials
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Ability.Type.Movement
    Description: Locomotion ability (sprint, climb)
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Resource nodes (gather targets; gate GA_Gather and pick the yielded material) ---
  - Tag: Resource.Node.Tree
    Description: A harvestable tree; yields wood
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Resource.Node.Rock
    Description: A harvestable rock/ore deposit; yields stone or ore
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Resource.Node.Bush
    Description: A forageable bush; yields edible berries
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Resource.Node.Water
    Description: A water source; a fill point for water containers
    AllowMultiple: false

  # --- Biome / environment (granted by area volumes; drive temperature exposure) ---
  - Tag: Biome.Temperate
    Description: Mild biome; temperature sits inside the comfort window
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Biome.Snow
    Description: Frozen biome; drives GE_Exposure_Cold
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Biome.Desert
    Description: Arid biome; drives GE_Exposure_Heat and faster thirst loss
    AllowMultiple: false
  - Tag: Environment.TimeOfDay.Night
    Description: Night; colder ambient temperature and reduced visibility
    AllowMultiple: false
```
